checks.label: robots.txt
checks.why: robots.txt tells crawlers what they may access.

checks.label: AI crawler rules
checks.detail: No explicit rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended). They use the default policy.

checks.label: Pagination markup
checks.detail: No rel=next/prev pagination markup (fine for most sites).

checks.label: hreflang
checks.detail: No hreflang tags — treated as a single-locale site.

checks.label: Unique titles
checks.detail: All crawled pages have unique titles.

checks.label: Meta descriptions (site)
checks.detail: Every crawled page has a meta description.

checks.label: Calls to Action (CTAs)
checks.detail: Found 37 actionable Call to Action (CTA) triggers / buttons on homepage.

checks.label: Internal Linking & Orphan Risk
checks.detail: 4 crawled page(s) have 1 or fewer incoming internal links (orphan risk).
checks.fix: Add contextual internal links to these pages from higher-authority parent pages.

checks.label: Unused CSS
checks.detail: Reduce unused CSS — Est savings of 264 KiB
checks.fix: See Lighthouse guidance for unused css.

checks.label: Server response (TTFB)
checks.detail: Initial server response time was short — Root document took 330 ms

checks.label: Readability
checks.fix: Aim for a Flesch score of 50–70.

checks.label: Primary keyword in title/H1
checks.detail: Primary topic "original source" isn't in the title or H1.
checks.fix: Work the primary topic into the title and H1.

checks.label: Author / E-E-A-T
checks.fix: Add visible authorship and author schema.

checks.label: About page
checks.detail: No About page found in internal links.
checks.fix: Publish an About page — a core trust/E-E-A-T signal.

checks.label: Viewport meta
checks.why: Mobile-first indexing means Google ranks the mobile version; a viewport is mandatory.

checks.label: Form labels
checks.fix: Associate a <label> (or aria-label) with every field.

checks.label: `button`, `link`, and `menuitem` elements do not have accessible names.
checks.fix: See the Lighthouse accessibility guidance for 'aria-command-name'.

checks.label: Heading elements are not in a sequentially-descending order
checks.fix: See the Lighthouse accessibility guidance for 'heading-order'.

checks.label: HTTPS
checks.why: HTTPS is a confirmed ranking signal and a trust requirement.

checks.label: SSL Certificate Expiration
checks.detail: SSL Certificate is valid for 64 days until 2026-12-24 (Issued by Let's Encrypt).

checks.label: Google Maps & GBP Visibility
checks.detail: No embedded Google Map or direct Google Business link found on site.
checks.fix: Embed a Google Maps iframe or link directly to your verified Google Business Profile.
checks.why: Google Maps presence strongly signals localized trust and supports Local Pack rankings.

checks.label: LocalBusiness Schema
checks.detail: No LocalBusiness schema markup detected on the site.
checks.fix: Add schema.org/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with address, telephone, openingHours, and geo coordinates.
checks.why: LocalBusiness schema directly qualifies your site for rich local results and Google Maps knowledge cards.

checks.label: Physical Address (NAP)
checks.detail: Physical address indicators detected on site.

checks.label: Reviews & Social Proof
checks.detail: Customer reviews, ratings, or testimonial signals detected.

checks.label: Domain Authority (DA)
checks.why: Higher domain authority correlates strongly with competitive keyword ranking capability.

checks.label: Outbound Link Ratio
checks.detail: Healthy outbound link profile (19 dofollow, 0 nofollow).

checks.label: Outbound Link Safety
checks.detail: No suspicious or spammy external link destinations detected.

checks.label: Font loading
checks.detail: No font preconnect/preload — text may flash or block.
